messages:
riley: Quick thread  proposal: hold Aurora-1-small from pinning until multilingual and embedding regressions are investigated. Sales wants a pilot but ops flagged regressions.

priya: What regressions?

riley: Embedding cosine drift on non-English data and lower recall on our cross-lingual bench. Also a few seed-dependent hallucination cases in long-form.

ethan: I can run an expanded bench (N=50 seeds) + 5 regional prompt sets in 48h. Need a GPU slot.

meera: Ops: if we allow pin now, we need a pin-probation TTL and an auto-unpin trigger based on cross-lingual recall dropping >2.5% vs baseline. Also require an artifact digest and tokenizer hash.

riley: Suggest flow: 1) catalog preview with "pilot-only" tag, 2) allow dedicated canary for the customer with explicit no-pin, 3) gate pin behind N=50 pass + tokenizer parity + artifact snapshot.

priya: Sales/CS note: customer will accept preview if we commit to a 7-day stabilization window and daily status updates.

ethan: Starting N=50 runs now. Will post results and sample diff.

opsbot: bench-bot: job queued id 2026-06-01-aurora-50seed

meera: Action items: ethan -> bench runs (2d), meera -> create pin-probation spec (auto-unpin rules, TTL 14d), riley -> draft catalog preview copy + comms.

priya: I'll let the customer know the preview+timeline.

riley: If N=50 shows <2% cross-lingual delta and no tokenizer mismatch, we allow a limited pin trial (14d TTL) under probation. Else we keep preview-only. Re-opening after bench results. :white_check_mark:
